item:water.title: Water (implicit 1 × 1)
item:water.description: Stored in one Inventory slot. Drop it on the 2 × 2 tree: the 3 × 1 result cannot use the target anchor while the survey peg blocks its extra cell, so merge placement must use the deterministic fallback.

item:survey-peg.title: Survey Peg (explicit 1 × 1)
item:survey-peg.description: A movable one-cell blocker. Two adjacent pegs are the bounded multi-collision drop target; the third forces merge fallback. The Toolbar copy proves storage remains one slot.

item:tree.title: Tree Plot (2 × 2)
item:tree.description: The differently sized merge target. Its occupied edge is also a visible reference for rectangle-based proximity.

item:double-tree.title: Windbreak (3 × 1)
item:double-tree.description: The deterministic result of watering the 2 × 2 tree. The blocked target-first anchor makes the standard exact-identity fallback observable.

item:beam.title: Relocation Beam (3 × 1)
item:beam.description: Drop this across both adjacent survey pegs. The source stays at the requested anchor while the initial two-identity collision set relocates through standard exact-item placement.

item:pallet.title: Stackable Pallet (2 × 2)
item:pallet.description: Two units begin compacted into one Inventory slot even though each unit occupies 2 × 2 on Board. Return and stack them on Board to exercise both storage and spatial rules.

item:landmark.title: Landmark (3 × 3)
item:landmark.description: A non-stackable Board landmark used to constrain the initial layout and evaluate readability, storage compaction, Board return, and actor bounds.

item:output-yard.title: Output Yard (2 × 3)
item:output-yard.description: Start the default line while the Board has no 3 × 3 opening. Completion must remain ready and publish nothing until rearrangement opens enough area; its output is ordered from this large owner's rectangle.

lines.title: Raise Landmark
lines.description: Produces one 3 × 3 landmark after a short delay.
